implementation: The slow fixture first performs the real product write and then holds the receipt. Once the file is observed, both real processes are killed with SIGKILL.

The complete default orchestration path performs client revocation and settlement checks. Unknown blocks capture on the first attempt and on resume; the same blocked verdict is not appended twice.
The test rereads the original operation after both attempts and confirms it remains unknown. No product source behavior changed.
